note: Stage N maps to Ehel Grade N. Objective code = <stage><subStrand>.01. Cambridge does not print objective codes in this framework; see codeScheme.

codeScheme.why: Global Perspectives publishes objectives as bare bullets under strand and sub-strand headings, with no codes. Units need a stable identifier to reference, so these codes are assigned during extraction. They are stable across re-extraction because they derive from the sub-strand, not from position on the page.
codeScheme.strandLetters: Reflection takes F and Communication takes M because R and C are already used by Research and Collaboration.

Select, organise and record relevant information from a range of sources and findings from research, using appropriate methods

Explain how graphical or numerical data supports an argument
Explain causes of a local or global issue and consequences on others
Suggest and justify different actions to make a positive difference to a national or global issue
Evaluate sources, considering the author and purpose, recognising that some sources may be biased
Discuss the effectiveness of a source, making explicit reference to its development of an argument
